title: Google and Voltus Expand PJM Virtual Power Plant to 1 GW

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Google and Voltus are growing their joint capacity to manage distributed energy resources within the United States' largest electricity market. The two companies are scaling their virtual power plant (VPP) initiative in the PJM region to more than 1 GW, up from 100MW, to better balance power loads for large data centers. This tenfold increase in capacity allows the firms to integrate a wider array of distributed assets into the grid.

The expansion signals a move toward flexible data center operations that can adjust electricity draw based on demand. By aggregating small-scale power sources to function as a single utility-scale plant, the project reflects growing confidence in the ability of VPP technology to maintain grid stability for hyperscale users.
